answer_1.quote: We propose a two‑stage training approach to generate Ladder Diagrams using LLMs... The model generates LD programs in various text formats (XML, JSON, metaprogram) from natural language instructions.
datasets: Ladder Diagram (LD) dataset from production environment
answer_1.outputs: LD programs represented as XML, JSON, or Python metaprogram code (NetworkX graph)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate generation quality using node F1, edge F1, and Program Exact Match (EM) scores... Partial correctness is measured using F1 scores, and Exact Match assesses complete correctness.

answer_4.quote: Three experienced LD programmers evaluated the generated code based on functionality and assigned scores on a scale of 1 to 5... Fleiss' kappa coefficient was reported to assess inter‑rater consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators scored each generated ladder program on functionality and practical applicability using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
